question:
What will be the value of the following expression?

0.25 ÷ 0.0025 × 0.025 × 25
solution:
**Given:**

0.25 ÷ 0.0025 × 0.025 × 25

**Concept used:**

BODMAS

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d0dde522f65134a981f8db6f1ac5aebe5108510a68c758df909f765f209687bd.png] 

The preference will be given on the basis of the letter coming first in the word BODMAS.

**Calculation: **

0.25 ÷ 0.0025 × 0.025 × 25

= 100 × 0.025 × 25

= 2.5 × 25

= 62.5

**Hence, The Required simplified value is 62.5.**
